protocol: Same as Phase 4 loadtest.py (rotating 20 tasks, stated roles, 3 rounds per agent, weights reset around each level), one process for all levels so the snapshot cache warms once and is shared — like a long-lived server. Levels run 10 -> 25 -> 50 in sequence; no level was re-run or dropped.
cache: meta_tools snapshot: 5 bulk catalog pulls cached per process, TTL 60 s, invalidated on report_outcome. MSpaths + entity lookup still live per call, so a warm call issues 2 HTTP queries instead of ~7.
